description: Search Argentina's national time-series catalog (apis.datos.gob.ar) for series matching a keyword. Titles/descriptions are in Spanish (e.g. q="inflacion", "pbi", "emae", "tipo de cambio", "desempleo"). Returns matching series with their ids (use these with get_series), titles, units, frequency, date coverage, dataset and source.

q.description: Search keyword in Spanish, e.g. "inflacion", "pbi", "tipo de cambio".

name: search_series
title: Search Series
